description: Raw access to the position as bitboards and arrays (E21), for bots with their own evaluation or move ordering.

functions.name: bitboard
functions.description: Squares with pieces of that color and type.

functions.name: bitboards
functions.description: All piece bitboards in one call.

functions.name: squares

returns.description: 64 entries, indexed by Square; NO_PIECE on empty squares.

functions.description: The whole board square by square in one call.

functions.name: piece_count
functions.description: Number of pieces of that color and type.

functions.name: attacks_from

returns.description: Empty if the square is empty.

functions.description: Squares attacked by the piece on that square with the current occupancy, including squares of own pieces; pawns attack diagonally only. Pins are ignored.

functions.name: attackers_of
functions.description: Pieces of that color that attack the square with the current occupancy. Pins are ignored.

functions.name: checkers
functions.description: Pieces giving check to the side to move.

functions.name: pinned
functions.description: Pieces of that color that are pinned to their own king by an enemy bishop, rook or queen.
